title: AI Video Designer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Turn briefs, product concepts, and offer ideas into engaging video concepts, hooks, scripts, and storyboards designed for Meta placements.
* Produce Reels and ad creatives end-to-end using generative AI (video, image, voice, music) alongside manual editing, motion graphics, and sound design.
* Write and test hooks: craft the critical first 3 seconds, then create variations of hooks, CTAs, lengths, and formats for each concept.
* Deliver assets in all required aspect ratios (9:16 for Reels/Stories, 4:5 and 1:1 for Feeds) with burned-in captions, safe zones, and brand-compliant graphics.
* Collaborate with performance marketers to analyze key ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and iterate on underperforming or fatigued creatives.
* Track social media trends, popular formats, viral audio, and competitor ads in the Meta Ad Library to adapt them for our brand.
* Build and maintain a reusable library of prompts, workflows, templates, LUTs, and brand kits for fast, consistent output.
* Review AI assets to ensure high visual quality, brand safety, copyright compliance, and adherence to platform ad policies.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 2–4 years in video editing or motion design, with at least 6 months of hands-on experience using generative AI video tools. (Freshers with an exceptional AI-generated portfolio will also be considered).
* **Video Editing:** Proficient in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve (at least two at a working level).
* **Motion Graphics:** Skilled in After Effects or CapCut templates for kinetic typography, lower thirds, callouts, and simple VFX.
* **Generative AI Tools:** Hands-on experience with AI video (Runway, Kling, Luma, Pika, Sora, Veo) and AI image/storyboard generators (Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion, Firefly).
* **Prompt Engineering:** Ability to write precise, repeatable prompts and troubleshoot visual glitches (e.g., hands, text rendering, character drift).
* **AI Audio & Voice:** Experience with voiceovers, lip-syncing, and audio generation using tools like ElevenLabs, Suno, Topaz, or HeyGen.
* **Meta Advertising Know-How:** Understanding of Meta ad specs, safe zones, hook-body-CTA structures, 3-second hook optimization, and creative testing.
* **Design & Storytelling:** Solid foundation in composition, typography, color grading, and scripting tight 15–45 second visual stories.
* **Working Traits:** High ownership, fast iteration speed, attention to detail, comfort with feedback, and a drive to learn new AI tools continuously.

**Good to Have (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with node-based workflows like ComfyUI.
* Video upscaling (Topaz Video AI, Magnific) and AI rotoscoping/masking.
* AI avatar and UGC-style ad creation tools (HeyGen, Synthesia, Arcads).
* E-commerce, D2C, education, or lead-generation ad campaign experience.
* Regional language content sense (Hindi/Hinglish) for Indian audiences.

title: Senior Specialist, UX Designer
description:
**Job Title:**

Senior Specialist, UX Designer

**Job Description:**

**The Role:**

Our site in **Pune, India**is seeking a **Mid-Level** **UX Designer** to join our team.

This person will work on a newly formed team that is helping shape the future of digital tools and platforms at Entegris.

You’ll work directly with highly technical and operationally savvy partners — engineers, scientists, operations leader, business leaders — to design intuitive, effective experiences that improve complex operational workflows, support R&D innovation efforts, empowering users throughout the ecosystem, from the shop floor to executives, to do their best work.  
  
This is a hands-on, highly autonomous role for someone who brings strong product thinking, thrives in complexity, and is excited to help build a new design practice from the ground up.  
  
As part of a newly forming Human-Centered Design team, this role offers the unique opportunity to help shape how design and research integrate into our organization. You’ll play an active part in establishing ways of working, lightweight processes, and best practices that enable high-impact outcomes within a lean, fast-moving environment. This is an ideal role for someone excited to help build not just great solutions — but a great design and research culture from the ground up.

**What****You’ll****Do****:**

* Own delivery for UX design for one or more product teams

* Develop user-centered solutions for AI-enabled tools, determining how emerging AI patterns support operational workflows.

* Collaborate with Human-Centered Design Leadership and cross-functional partners (engineers, scientists, operations and business leaders) to understand business processes, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and design effective digital tools.

* Conduct research and create end-to-end design artifacts, including journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and annotated specs.

* Frame and communicate design rationale to developers, product owners, and business stakeholders.

* Work closely with product teams to bring concepts to life and ensure usability and consistency.

* Participate in user validation, iteration, and team ceremonies throughout the product development cycle.

* Help shape our AI-forward design pipeline

* Help shape our Design System by designing/establishing new components and patterns to meet business needs, coordinating with our software engineering team in Pune, India

**What We Seek****:**

* A systems thinker who understands complex ecosystems and designs purposeful, efficient solutions.

* A self-starter who brings clarity to ambiguity and moves work forward confidently.

* A team member invested in continuous learning, with an AI-forward design/development mindset.

* A team member who is:

* Energized by working at the intersection of AI, advanced technology, and human-centered design.

* Excited to help shape how design integrates into a fast-evolving, high-growth digital organization.

* Excited to play an active role in establishing and evolving our human-centered design practice, helping define how we work and grow as a team.

* Strong in communication and committed to continuous learning.

* Comfortable working with agile teams.

* Curious about data, systems, and business context.

* Skilled at documenting features, workflows, and user needs.

* Able to align user experience with technical feasibility and business priorities.

**Outstanding****Candidates****Will****Have****:**

* 3-5 years of UX design experience, with a portfolio showcasing complex workflows, systems thinking, and enterprise-grade solutions.

Specifics: You don’t need to check every box, but you should bring strong experience in many of these areas and a willingness to grow into the rest.

* **Enterprise & Domain Expertise**

* Experience designing for enterprise tools and operational workflows.

* Familiarity with dashboard design and tools used in manufacturing or supply chain contexts.

* Industry experience in manufacturing and supply chain is a strong bonus; B2B life sciences, pharmaceutical, medical device, and biotechnology sectors also considered.

* **AI & Emerging Technologies**

* Experience designing for AI-driven platforms, including systems that incorporate automation, feedback loops, or agent-based UX.

* Familiarity with platforms like Google Cloud’s AI suite or comparable technologies.

* **Design Craft & Tools**

* Highly proficient in Figma for wireframing, prototyping, and design system management.

* Strong expertise in journey mapping, service design, and simplifying complex or technical processes.

* **Collaboration & Communication**

* Comfortable working directly with engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders throughout the design process.

* Strong communication and facilitation skills; able to clearly present design decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**What We Offer:**

At Entegris, we invest in providing opportunity to our employees and promote from within. The new hire in this role will have the potential to grow and create relationships across the organizationand be recognized for demonstrated success and adherence to company PACE values.

Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.

* Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match

* Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs

* Flexible work schedule and 11 paid holidays a year

* Paid time off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge

* Education assistance to support your learning journey

* Values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence.

*At Entegris we are committed to**providing**equal opportunity**to**all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities,**achievements**and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.*

*Entegris strongly encourages**all of**its employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19. At Entegris, COVID-19 vaccination is preferred but not**required**at this time.*

**Intelligent Manufacturing** is on an exciting growth journey, building the new digital era of manufacturing. Our objective is to make the shift towards efficient and sustainable manufacturing. As the market leader in CAM and metrology software with over 400,000 software licenses and a global footprint, we have a unique foundation to build on. Please read more about us here .


At **Metrologic Group** , part of Sandvik — a global industrial technology leader — we build the software backbone of modern manufacturing quality. Our solutions connect design, production, and inspection into a seamless digital feedback loop, used by 15,000\+ engineers across 60 countries, including the world's top aerospace, automotive, and energy companies.


Somewhere right now, an engineer at an aerospace company is validating a jet engine component. A team at an automotive plant is catching a defect before it reaches the line. A precision manufacturer is closing the loop between their CAD design and the physical world — in real time.


That's possible because of software like ours. And this also shows what software quality means to us.
